faq.title: questions, answered.
faq.one.question: is SavePop free to use?
faq.one.answer: yes. SavePop is free, open source and does not use ads, paid tiers or artificial download limits. community instances may have their own fair-use rate limits.
faq.two.question: which websites can SavePop download from?
faq.two.answer: SavePop supports youtube, tiktok, instagram, x, reddit, twitch, vimeo, soundcloud and many other public media platforms. the live platform list above reflects the selected instance.
faq.three.question: does SavePop keep my downloads?
faq.three.answer: no. SavePop acts as a streaming proxy and does not permanently store downloaded media. temporary browser storage may be used when your device merges or converts a file.
faq.four.question: can i download private or protected content?
faq.four.answer: no. SavePop is intended only for freely accessible public content and does not bypass DRM or access controls. you are responsible for respecting copyright and platform terms.
